answer: A mechanism that actually bites: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because shale only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, copper is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
